meta.name: MECHFALL // FORGE 77 — full model / trace library
meta.note: The ONLY allowed full models and traces are the 30 example chassis below. Each is a complete procedural model and a front/side/top blueprint trace derived exclusively from that example's own shape vector + signature-part composition in chassis.json. No ripped, imported, extracted, traced-from-screenshot or base-mod geometry is used.

policy.note: A chassis is allowed only when its signature-part composition comes from the example library (7 slots / 59 original procedural part types). Generic untyped hulls, numeric-only scaling and any model source outside these 30 examples are rejected. Players still mix example parts freely — the emphasis stays fully customisable chassis + player-designed internals.
